_comment: Each area declares path globs (repo-root-relative, forward slashes) that were built
AHEAD of an explicit owner go-ahead. A commit that stages a file matching one of these
globs WARNS (advisory, like the TOCTOU heuristic) unless the decision-log carries a
matching `SCOPE-UNLOCK: <area>` line — which is how the owner signals the area is now
in-scope. Set `hardBlock: true` on an area to escalate that area from a warning to a
HARD BLOCK (the pre-commit hook aborts the commit) until it is unlocked.
Emergency bypass for ANY gate in this repo:  git commit --no-verify
Seeded from the Instagram/Messenger channel work landed in commits
dfde910 d338561 6316157 518ac21 b1b6cd4 07c5c23 cbbedd3 (channel adapter + connect +
inbound webhook + channel-aware engine). These shipped as Phase-0 groundwork; this
manifest keeps further build on those surfaces gated on an explicit owner SCOPE-UNLOCK.

areas.description: Instagram + Facebook Messenger channel adapter, connect flow, and inbound webhook — the non-WhatsApp channels built ahead of an explicit owner go-ahead.
Channel-aware conversation engine + per-channel flow scoping + multi-channel inbox — engine/route surfaces that became channel-aware for IG/Messenger.
